standard-dialogue-if-the-player-does-not.npc: I bet you're after another lens!

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-does-not.player: How could you possibly know that?

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-does-not.npc: Hey, I think I'm learning a thing or two from these Moon Clan ladies.

steps.player: Oi! I need another lens, boy.

steps.text: If the player does not have inventory space:

steps.npc: Huh, oh ok, I suppose I owe you one.

steps.player: I think I'll pass. But thanks..

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-already-.player: So you've plucked up the courage to come and confront that girl!

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-already-.npc: That I did, that I did!
She turned out to be really nice! She's joining us to become a pirate!

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-already-.player: Really? And you're not sceptical about this? You know, after what she did last time?
Huh? Why are you talking like that?
Like someone else was talking for you. Are you sure she hasn't put a spell on you again? Did she wave a watch in front of your face? You know, tell you to look deep into her eyes?
I think you've been hypnotised. I wonder what happens if I click my fingers?
Oh dear. Oh well, I'm sure you'll learn one day.
